titre: Un ingénieur camerounais en intelligence artificielle
titre_en: A Cameroonian engineer in artificial intelligence
resume: Portrait retraçant sa formation entre le Cameroun et le Maroc, son parcours d'ingénieur puis de docteur, et son engagement constant pour la transmission du savoir.
resume_en: A profile tracing his education between Cameroon and Morocco, his path from engineer to PhD, and his ongoing commitment to sharing knowledge.
